children: The Glamsterdam upgrade is scheduled to activate on the Hoodi testnet on October 26 at 17:42:48 UTC, or October 27 at 1:42:48 AM (UTC+8), with the network’s block gas limit set to rise to 200 million. According to ChainCatcher, the Ethereum Foundation announced the schedule on October 16. The upgrade includes enshrined proposer-builder separation, block-level access lists, and changes to gas accounting. Sepolia activated the upgrade on October 6, while an Ethereum mainnet upgrade date has not been set. Node operators must update their execution- and consensus-layer clients before activation on Hoodi.

title: Ethereum Foundation Schedules Glamsterdam Upgrade for Hoodi Testnet on October 27
